title: Question 30
passage:
The timer sounds in the control room, but I can’t hear it from the wash station.
A. The wash cycle uses less water now. B. We changed the control room clock yesterday. C. Let’s put a signal light where you can see it.
passageZh:
控制室的計時器會響，但我在清洗工作站聽不到。
A. 現在清洗循環用的水比較少。 B. 我們昨天換了控制室的時鐘。 C. 我們把警示燈裝在你看得到的位置吧。
